headerDisplay: Apple Home for your CarLinko car, through your own [OpenLinko](https://github.com/GodrezJr2/openlinko) dashboard. The plugin only talks to OpenLinko: it never logs in to CarLinko itself, so OpenLinko must be running and logged in with an account the car's T-Box accepts.
footerDisplay: Engine start is deliberately not exposed. Remote commands need the car to have mobile signal; a sleeping car may take a moment or not confirm.

host.title: OpenLinko IP address or host name

https.title: Use HTTPS
https.description: Only if OpenLinko is behind an HTTPS proxy.

password.title: Dashboard password
password.description: Only if you set a dashboard password in OpenLinko. Leave empty otherwise.

carName.title: Car name
carName.description: Used for the tile names: "Car", "Car A/C", "Find Car"... Say "Hey Siri, lock the Car".

charging.title: Charging sensor (detected while charging; for automations)

defaultTemp.title: A/C temperature until the car reports one (°C)

windows.title: Windows: open / close (all together; the car has no per-window command)

windowsVent.title: Windows Vent switch (on = vent all, off = close all)

windowSensors.title: Window status sensors (which window is open; read-only)

sunroofTilt.title: Sunroof Tilt switch (on = tilt, off = close)

liftgate.title: Power liftgate / boot
liftgate.description: Shown as a garage door, so Home asks for Face ID / passcode before opening it.

doors.title: Doors contact sensor (any door or the boot open)

enabled.title: Show a "Car Home" sensor
enabled.description: Needs OpenLinko's car location feature ("location": true). Great for automations: car arrives, porch light on.

mapTileUrl.title: Map tile server (settings page only)
mapTileUrl.description: Leave empty to use OpenStreetMap. Another server must be https with {z}, {x} and {y}; you then have to follow that server's terms and fill in its required credit below.

mapAttribution.title: Map credit for that server
mapAttribution.description: Shown on the map, as most tile servers require. Not needed for OpenStreetMap (its credit is built in).

layout.title: Tiles
layout.description: Only tiles your car supports are created, whatever is ticked here.

layout.title: Settings page map
layout.description: The map on this page uses OpenStreetMap tiles, under the OSMF Tile Usage Policy.
